test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting in a straight line. E is 4th from the right. E is between B and D. A is adjacent to B. D is adjacent to C. D is between E and C. F is adjacent to C. Who is sitting between F and D?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Six friends are sitting in a straight line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c49d0c8dab0dcf3228857fa45ec97bb83793d188b0d88713bcab7329d4ebb18.png] 

1. E is 4th from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/430724e72f0b65cc4cff2a13e20157c14669ddd1f0b347b233a7a8e075553156.png] 

2. E is between B and D.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a32a516850b99cfc77c4e9d9cd9f7d2f935a9e6d100ca2c182675b0982d8d9cd.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c4ed7f51eb43c765d963ef27f74083dd375b386269abadfe20e110d357eacd.png] 

3. D is between E and C and D is adjacent to C.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2bc81deb8032618dc81bf070c425e1a03586b27ec2b6f6a9c88c9e01695343.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b7c4b68025d73d379e1dfcfaa036cf2a1c42b03d327feab56030ed5ab68e20f.png] 

4. F is adjacent to C.

So, here case (i) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ba0d625dc7261aab3dc5da5bb08a217240fab8b98ff0353aa0c39dcc263e79.png] 

5. A is adjacent to B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57ddf1cf0d9afa184862b5d66a05ccbf46ec337b5f1ec00df808e5f6bfdaefd6.png] 

∴ Here, 'C' is sitting between F and D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
